sloka: स पर्वतं समारुह्य कञ्चिद्रम्यवनान्तरम् ।अपश्यत् पुष्पकं तत्र रामविष्टम्भितं तदा ।। ७.१६.३ ॥
transliteration: sa parvataṁ samāruhya kañcidramyavanāntaram ।apaśyat puṣpakaṁ tatra rāmaviṣṭambhitaṁ tadā ।। 7.16.3 ॥

translations.english: Then, having ascended a certain mountain with beautiful forest interiors, he saw the Pushpaka aerial chariot stopped there by Rama.
